title: Delivery details / التوصيل
text: For delivery, collect the customer name, phone number, area, full address and requested date before confirming an order.

title: Catalogue pricing / الأسعار
text: Unit prices come from the business catalogue. Unknown products require owner review and manual pricing. Totals exclude delivery fees and taxes.

title: Owner approval / التأكيد
text: Extraction creates a draft only. The owner reviews the source message, corrects details and explicitly confirms. Confirmed drafts cannot be edited.
